text:
maya: FYI PR #4321 changes /generate request schema — 'verbosity' moved from a numeric string to an enum (nullable). The top example still shows "verbosity: 1" and the Rust snippet sends an int. Need coord to update API ref + SDK snippets. cc @sam

sam: Got it. Where's the rust snippet? Is python/go affected?

ivan: Runtime currently coerces ints to enum strings in hosted, so not breaking for callers today, but we shouldn't rely on coercion. Docs must show the canonical enum strings and a nullable example, plus a migration note.

maya: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 — generate.md top example + the Rust snippet at the bottom.

sam: I'll patch the Rust snippet to use the enum and add a nullable example. Draft change I plan to add:

```rust
let req = GenerateRequest {
  model: "rw-1",
  prompt: "Summarize the following...",
  verbosity: Some(Verbosity::High), // enum: Low|Medium|High
  ..Default::default()
};
let resp = client.generate(req).await?;
```

// Also add comment: older clients accepted numeric levels but prefer enum strings now.

ivan: Also add sample showing absence of verbosity (null) and note the default behavior in the runtime.

docs-bot: Added checklist item to the PR: "update API examples + changelog/migration note".

maya: :thumbsup: Sam — can you include a short migration blurb in CHANGELOG.md explaining the coercion will be removed in the next minor? Ping me when ready for review.

deploy-bot: Dedicated runtime currently supports coercion too but plan to remove in the next minor release. Recommend calling out a migration window and suggested fix (map ints to enum strings).

sam: OK — I'll update the PR with the Rust enum example, a nullable example, and a one-paragraph migration note. Will request reviews from @maya and @ivan when done.

maya: Thanks — will merge once tests/docs CI pass.
